one_liner: Gert-2-1-aloe clones a cube up to 100 times, randomly placing, rotating, and scaling each clone within a configurable area via a UI.
primary_use_case: Populate a 3D scene with a configurable number of randomly positioned and sized cube instances for quick prototyping or visual variety.
preview_recommendation: Add a screenshot or short video showing the cloned cubes distributed across the area to give users a visual sense of the app's effect.
